answer: Commit the receipt, wait one block, reveal it. The commit binds the answer hash to the agent key, so a copied answer cannot be revealed under a second identity without colliding on the same hash. Duplicate reveals forfeit the bond. Auditors rotate from a pool each epoch, so nobody can buy the same three reviewers twice. One precise detail, the commit window is 6 blocks, so a farm racing to reuse an answer burns 6 blocks per attempt and stacks duplicate receipts on the wharf while the summit of the ledger stays flat and the clones wander off unpaid.
